name: Seated Leg Raise
steps: Sit near the front edge of the bench and grasp its sides just behind your hips.
Lean back slightly, brace your abdomen and extend your legs together in front of you.
Lift both straight legs smoothly upward in front of your torso using your hip flexors and abs.
Lower your legs slowly back down until your heels hover just above the floor.
tips: Avoid swinging your torso far back and forth to kick your legs higher.
Keep your lower back steady rather than letting it arch harshly as your legs descend.
